We need propose retrosynthesis route up to 3 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <=9999 (we can't check price but assume buyable). Need to construct JSON route.

Target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need break into precursors. Likely disconnection: sulfonamide formation between an aniline (p-tolyl amine) and sulfonyl chloride derived from p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride? Actually target has sulfonamide linking two aromatic rings: p-tolyl sulfonyl attached to an aniline of second ring which also has an amide side chain with anilide.

Structure: p-tolyl (CH3) phenyl attached to N-SO2- attached to second phenyl which has a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (para-? Actually Nc3ccccc3N). So second phenyl has para-? The side chain: /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph-NH2 (aniline). So we could disconnect amide formation between acrylic acid chloride and aniline.

Potential route:

Step1: Form sulfonamide: React p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride (Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1) with aniline derivative that already contains the side chain (maybe 4-aminophenyl with side chain). The other component: 4-aminophenyl with side chain: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2-NH2? Actually the sulfonamide attaches to N of that ring, so we need aniline (para-aminophenyl) bearing the side chain. So precursor A: 4-aminophenyl with side chain (C= C etc). That could be made via amide coupling of acryloyl chloride with aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). Wait side chain attaches to that phenyl via amide to aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). So we need an aniline (anilide) attached to acrylic acid.

Thus we could have precursor B: 4-aminophenyl (c2ccc(N)cc2) and then do a Heck-type? Actually side chain is attached via C=C to phenyl, not via substitution. It's a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to phenyl via double bond (styryl amide). So we could form via Wittig or Heck coupling of acryloyl amide with bromophenyl.

Simplify: Use commercially available 4-bromoaniline? But we need double bond.

Maybe easier: Use commercially available 4-aminostyrene (p-aminostyrene) which is C= C attached to phenyl with NH2. Then do amide formation with acryloyl chloride? Actually p-aminostyrene already has C=C attached to phenyl, but we need C=C attached to carbonyl amide: /C=C/C(=O)N-Ph-NH2. That's a cinnamamide derivative. Could be made by coupling acryloyl chloride with aniline to give acryloyl anilide (C=CC(=O)Nc3ccccc3N). Then perform a Heck coupling with 4-bromo phenyl sulfonamide? Actually the double bond attaches to phenyl ring via C=C linking to phenyl (styryl). So we need to attach the acryloyl anilide to phenyl via Heck coupling (aryl bromide + acrylamide). So precursor: 4-bromo-? Actually the phenyl that will be sulfonylated also has the double bond attached at para position relative to sulfonamide? In target, the sulfonyl phenyl (second phenyl) has the double bond at para to sulfonamide? Let's examine: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2 attached to sulfonamide at position 1 (the N attaches to sulfonyl). The double bond substituent is at para position relative to sulfonamide (since pattern c2ccc(... )cc2). So we need 4-bromo-? Actually we need a phenyl with bromine at para to sulfonamide after sulfonylation? The sulfonamide attaches at position 1, the double bond at para (position 4). So we could start with 4-bromo-? Wait we need sulfonyl chloride reacting with aniline (the phenyl with side chain). So we need aniline that already has the side chain at para. So we need 4-(cinnamoyl)aniline? Actually the side chain is C=C-C(=O)N-Ph-NH2 attached to phenyl via double bond. So the aniline is the phenyl with double bond substituent (cinnamoyl anilide). So we need 4-(cinnamoyl)aniline (para-aminophenyl with trans-cinnamoyl anilide). That could be made by Heck coupling of 4-bromoaniline with acryloyl anilide (C=CC(=O)Nc3ccccc3N). So step1: Heck coupling to give 4-(cinnamoyl)aniline. Step2: Sulfonamide formation with p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride.

Thus total steps 2.

Now need to ensure precursors are commercially available: p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride (Cc1ccc(S(=O)(=O)Cl)cc1) is buyable (we saw true). 4-bromoaniline (Brc1ccc(N)cc1) is likely buyable. Acryloyl anilide (C=CC(=O)Nc3ccccc3N) maybe not directly buyable but we can make from acryloyl chloride and aniline (both buyable). However we need leaves only commercially available chemicals, not intermediates. So we could have three leaf nodes: p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride, 4-bromoaniline, acryloyl chloride + aniline? But acryloyl chloride is a reagent, aniline is buyable. However the route must be tree with reactions; each reaction can have multiple precursors. So we could have two reactions: first reaction: amide formation between acryloyl chloride and aniline to give acryloyl anilide. Second reaction: Heck coupling between 4-bromoaniline and that amide to give 4-(cinnamoyl)aniline. Third reaction: sulfonamide formation between p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride and that product to give target. That's 3 steps, leaves: acryloyl chloride, aniline, 4-bromoaniline, p-tolyl sulfonyl chloride. All likely buyable.

We need template IDs for these reactions. We need to search for templates: amide formation (acyl chloride + amine). sulfonamide formation (sulfonyl chloride + amine). Heck coupling (aryl bromide + alkene). Let's search.
